prompts.text: # new-app-wizard Orchestrator build ID: new-app-wizard (profile current). Use that record: follow its steps and the model the orchestrator set for each step, tick steps as you finish, record session and cost on it. Build a New App wizard (console screen, voice, API/MCP/CLI). It asks for: app name, quick summary, brief, and subdomain on amberxai.com. Then it: creates a GitHub repo under MossesX; scaffolds a framework app with standard style and assets, a settings interface and a control panel; adds the Hostinger DNS record for the subdomain; sets up HTTPS and VPS routing behind Brett's login; …
prompts.output: Boss, new-app-wizard is stopped before it started: **the VPS disk is full and no code got written.** `/` is 193 GB with about 1 MB free, swinging down to 0, so this shit's hitting the whole box. `docker exec` into `axf-console` now dies with "no space left", and other builds are likely choking too.…
